The BMW Z3 / Z4 family

3 generations and variants in the Index, 1998–2016. Oldest first; every card opens the full page, with its own versions, figures and story.

  1. 1998–2002

    BMW Z3 M Coupe

    A Z3 roadster given a fixed roof, a glass hatchback tail and an M3 engine, it looked so strange that critics called it the Clown Shoe. Beneath the joke was a body far stiffer than the roadster's and one of the most vivid small cars BMW has ever made.

    315 hp4.8 sec 0-60162 mph top6,291 built
    S54 · S52
  2. 2006–2008

    BMW Z4 M Coupe

    The second, more serious attempt at a small M coupe, with a fastback roof, the 330-hp S54 straight-six, a 6-speed manual and hydraulic steering. It is quicker, stiffer and more composed than the Z3 version, and rarer too.

    330 hp4.8 sec 0-60160 mph top4,581 built
  3. 2010–2016

    BMW Z4 sDrive35is

    The most powerful E89 Z4, pairing a 335-hp twin-turbo six with a 7-speed dual-clutch gearbox, adaptive suspension and a folding metal roof. It was tuned for scenic detours rather than lap records, and it has aged into one of the most quietly appealing BMW roadsters.

    335 hp4.5 sec 0-60155 mph top118,444 built
